steps.title: Setup Project Configuration
steps.description: Initialize the Android Gradle project with compilation settings matching AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, and SDK 34.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with clean material configurations, target orientation, application name, package layout, and system icon configurations.

steps.title: Define Color Palette
steps.description: Establish a sleek, premium dark-themed color scheme consisting of deep blacks, modern gunmetal greys, highlight oranges, and clean text colors.

steps.title: Create Rounded Number Button Background
steps.description: Design a custom XML drawable specifying modern rounded shapes for standard numeric keypad buttons.

steps.title: Create Rounded Operator Button Background
steps.description: Design a glowing accent-orange rounded rectangle drawable for operator controls to provide a beautiful high-contrast UI.

steps.title: Create Rounded Action Button Background
steps.description: Design sleek light-grey rounded drawables for action controls such as Clear and Backspace.

steps.title: Design Modern Calculator User Interface
steps.description: Build layout activity_main.xml with a dual-line display (Formula & Result) and a highly responsive nested linear key layout for flawless alignment across all device sizes.

steps.title: Develop MainActivity Core Logic
steps.description: Implement MainActivity with modern, bug-free expression management, input parsing state-machines, formatting functions, and full Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Implement Event Listeners
steps.description: Register standard Java-8-compliant anonymous onClick event listeners on all numeric, operational, and structural buttons.

steps.title: Deploy Math Parser and Logic Engine
steps.description: Integrate calculation functions handling addition, subtraction, division, multiplication, percentages, decimals, sign toggling, and clean visual double-to-string format mapping.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build, compile, and finalize the Modern Calculator package.
